title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend custody hearing in New York | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a custody hearing in New York on 28 June 1971.

It took place at the New York Supreme Court in Mineola, Nassau County, on Long Island, NY. Lennon and Ono were attempting to gain custody of her seven-year-old daughter Kyoko, and believed her to be in New York state.

During the hearing, Lennon and Ono’s attorney Sidyey I Siben told the court that they believed Kyoko was being hidden on board a boat moored off Bellport in Long Island. The child’s paternal grandfather, George Cox, testified to the contrary, telling Justice Albert A Oppigo that she was not in the state.

The judge dismissed Ono’s suit, telling her that there was no evidence of Kyoko’s presence in New York.
